description:
Search the motion library: UI animations and micro-interactions (button presses, toggles,
toasts, number tickers, check-offs, thinking states, hover effects, sounds) from open-source
libraries and designers' recordings, each with an exact spec and most with vanilla code. Any
word can match ("habit streak tick" finds check-offs); more matched words rank higher. Use it
when an interactive element should feel finished, then get_motion for the spec and code.
To audit a whole library: source=<id> fields=brief lists every entry in one call, with counts
by category and by the source's own sections, and which code each has (vanilla, react,
install, npm). For a whole UI, suggest_polish maps its parts to entries and sounds.

basis.description: Where the numbers come from - code (exact, read from source), video (measured from a recording) or rebuild.

category.description:
Comma-separated categories (OR): button, toggle, input, list, card, navigation, overlay,
toast, loader, text, number, chat-ai, cursor, scroll, transition, icon, feedback, media,
sound, other.

fields.description: brief gives one short row per entry (id, title, category, group, code), up to 100 per call.

hasCode.description: Only entries with working code (a vanilla rebuild or original source).

limit.description: Maximum results, 1 to 50 (100 with fields=brief, its default).

offset.description: Results to skip; pass nextOffset from the previous page.

source.description: Comma-separated source ids, as listed by get_motion_guidelines.

trigger.description: Comma-separated triggers (OR) - hover, press, click, focus, load, scroll, drag, state-change, loop, type.

name: search_motion
title: Search UI animations and micro-interactions
